testcase.name: inventory mass and backpack upgrades enforce a finite capacity
opening chapter has an explicit completion state without ending the open game
fresh water collection completes the forage objective even after the water was used
new player tutorial follows real movement materials water tool and food actions
eating consumes one item and restores clamped survival values
starvation dehydration and storms cause health loss instead of only changing labels
tools lose durability per action and break only when durability reaches zero
guided objective advances from foraging through first night preparation
renewable resource nodes recover with world time but mineral deposits stay depleted
hotbar is an explicit eight slot loadout instead of the first eight inventory entries
using a shelter advances time and restores stamina without ignoring hunger and thirst
axe and pickaxe never satisfy the same harvest requirement
